en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a calm lagoon or harbor with two people in a small rowboat in the foreground. Low traditional houses line the waterfront on the left, with low hills in the distance. The water is still, reflecting the buildings. Greek text appears at the lower left, French and/or transliterated text at the lower right, and a circular seal and website watermark are visible.
